assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The service is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I49.9.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events due to the paroxysmal nature of symptoms and need for continuous rhythm correlation.
The payer letter invites supporting clinical documentation justifying medical necessity.
